title: Ops Resilience: Never Again
description: Power's back. Parliament wants answers — and a plan.
storyContext: Power is back; most people will never know how close it got. The PM knows. One week to tell Parliament who did this, how, and what stops it forever.

software-engineer.title: Design the Permanent Defence
software-engineer.instruction: The attack slipped through the gap between station systems and office networks. Propose the fix.
software-engineer.hint: Close the gap without locking yourself out too.

options.label: [[Zero trust]] — every connection must prove itself, nothing trusted by default. Gold standard; takes 18 months.
options.consequence: Eighteen months of rollout begins. Painful, slow — and every audit after calls it the decision that mattered.

options.label: AI security centre watching around the clock, auto-responding to known threats. Live in 3 months.
options.consequence: Three months later, the AI catches its first intruder at 4am and locks them out before anyone wakes. Nice.

options.label: Cut critical systems from the internet forever. Ultimate defence; every update needs someone on-site.
options.consequence: The cables are cut — literally. Attackers can't get in remotely. Neither can your engineers. The vans get busy.

options.label: Regional programme — neighbouring utilities share attack intel in real time. One detects, all are warned.
options.consequence: Six months in, a neighbour flags an attack at 2am — same pattern. This time, Singapore is ready first.

data-scientist.title: Build the Evidence Case
data-scientist.instruction: Intel points to a state-backed group; Parliament needs solid proof. Order the investigation.
data-scientist.hint: Facts before conclusions. Be honest about certainty.

items.label: Compare their methods against known attacker groups
Trace traffic back through disguised relays
Study the malicious code like handwriting
Match attack times to suspects' time zones

data-scientist.consequenceSuccess: Method, source, style, and timing all point one way. Parliament gets a case that stands up.
data-scientist.consequenceFail: Conclusion first, evidence after — a sharp MP pulls one thread and the case wobbles. Rebuild it properly.

cloud-engineer.title: Design the Defence Architecture
cloud-engineer.instruction: Defend in layers: stop, spot, react, recover. Match each tool to its layer.
cloud-engineer.hint: Each tool has one job — which layer is it?

items.label: Backup Control Centre — takes over if main falls
Weakness Finder — finds gaps before attackers
Protected Backup Vault — clean, untouchable backups

cloud-engineer.consequenceSuccess: Four layers, each covering the next one's blind spot. The red team hired to test it comes back humbled.
cloud-engineer.consequenceFail: A responder in the prevention layer means attacks get answered but never blocked. Swap the layers around.
